selection_policy.admission: ADDENDUM 6 §6.1: a component is admitted on its sealed frozen-review verdict, not on free-run token match, which the addendum retires to a diagnostic column.
selection_policy.block_exclusivity: NOTES-MX-K §2.1: a block hosts at most one folded LANE.  The operator lane (short_conv / full_attention) writes operator.output upstream of the block's FFN norm; the feed-forward lane reads that norm.  Folding both in one block solves the MLP against a residual the operator fold has already moved -- measured at -3 review cases for mlp_gate and -4 for mlp_down against the same block's conv writer, while the two MLP tensors together in one block cost nothing.  Two components in the SAME lane are therefore allowed; two lanes are refused.
selection_policy.install_order: topological, input side -> output side; within a layer conv -> attention -> mlp -> norms (matrix_composition.install_order_key)
selection_policy.ranking: greedy, block-exclusive; a rung is kept only if the composed child stays alive-degraded or better (>= 8/15) and is not dead by the degeneracy clause
selection_policy.site_scope: ADDENDUM 5 rule 2-S under ADDENDUM 7's widened registry: a site that schema v2 registers has NO evidence attached to it by being registered.  Every rung is measured or it is nothing.
selection_policy.storage_floor: Cyril's hard rule: every folded component stores at or below a true quarter (S4) or eighth (S8) of its OWN parent tensor.  No sub-4x level is solved, sealed, or used as a fallback; a cell whose technique cannot express 4x at its site is dropped, never folded shallower.
